summary: Implemented merge(base, override) in settings/merge.py per ADR-004: recursive dict merge, lists and scalars replaced, None removes keys, and inputs are deep-copied so neither is mutated. Wrote ANALYSIS.md first and added tests for nested merge, type replacement, list replacement, None removal, non-mutation, and load() folding; all 10 tests pass.
assumptions: A None value inside a nested override that creates a new dict is dropped too (the new subtree is merged into an empty dict), so no None values survive from an override.
None entries inside lists are kept as-is, since ADR-004 says lists are replaced wholesale and not inspected.
The test run uses the repo root as the import root so that settings.merge and settings.load import correctly.
